full_spec_read_boundary: These25 complete149 specs directly read in this recheck, including descriptions/includes/excludes/owners/applicability/dimensions/prefixes/neighbors. This is not an all149 read or automatic role assignment. Some had been read earlier; no duplicate unique-review credit.

full_spec.description_ko: 소유자가 특정 시점에 수행하는 동작: 시선·연속 절차·정지 자세가 섞임; 과정 단계와 순간 동작 구별

includes: A declared actor or object performing one concrete activity at the selected instant.

full_spec.description: Explicitly selected adult presentation context; adulthood alone is not sexual styling.
full_spec.description_ko: 명시적으로 선택된 성인 표현 맥락: 성인 연령 조건과 분리; 성인 등장 자체는 성적 표현 근거가 아님
excludes: 성인 연령 조건과 분리; 성인 등장 자체는 성적 표현 근거가 아님
includes: Explicitly selected adult presentation context; adulthood alone is not sexual styling.

full_spec.description: Owned physical residue of an explicitly declared prior event, distinct from an arbitrary surface state or ongoing process.
full_spec.description_ko: 명시된 사건 뒤 남은 물리 흔적: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
excludes: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
includes: Owned physical residue of an explicitly declared prior event, distinct from an arbitrary surface state or ongoing process.

full_spec.description: Explicitly declared age range or visible age presentation of an identified carrier or its explicitly owned local region; local appearance does not establish whole-owner chronological age, and intrinsic adult restrictions remain unchanged.
full_spec.description_ko: 대상 또는 실제로 소유된 국소 영역의 명시된 연령 범위·보이는 연령 표현. 국소적인 나이 들어 보임·젊어 보임을 주체 전체의 실제 연령으로 확대하지 않으며, 기존 성인 제한은 그대로 누적한다.
excludes: Generic matte/glossy/rough texture, synthetic-skin material, wrinkles or a skin-region name alone without explicitly declared age presentation.
Chronological age, birth/manufacture history, adulthood, species, identity, health or family inferred from local skin or a provenance label.
Aged finish on non-skin material, weathering or damage alone is not subject/region visible age presentation merely because the adjective old/aged appears.

Part ownership is not equivalence: local region age appearance cannot be moved to the whole owner or another region. Distinct actual regions can legitimately have contrasting values on the same whole owner.

Selected age appearance remains E; explicit existing declared-age prerequisites retain P and cannot be used as permission to mutate locked age. Adult/human/domain source guards are neither inferred nor removed.
includes: Keep explicitly declared whole-carrier age range and visible age presentation, without inferring real chronological age from appearance.

An explicitly aged-looking versus young-looking owned skin-region contrast is local visible age presentation. Retain each actual region and owner; no new person, baby, exact age, family relation or global aged/young assignment follows.
A represented or synthetic carrier only receives the visible age presentation actually stated for its own region; representation identity alone is not a living age fact.

When one selection explicitly expresses both local skin microtexture and age appearance, appearance and age are two permission projections of that same semantic selection. Author both footprints consistently under the current proof contract; this is not an instruction for engine inference, automatic duplication or removal of locks.

full_spec.description: Ownership and continuity, articulation, attachment or explicitly intended separation of anatomical parts of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation; non-anatomical artifact joins remain separate.
full_spec.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 해부학적 부위 소유·연속·관절·부착 또는 명시적으로 의도된 분리이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 꽃·잎·자기 줄기 연결도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 형태·비율·단순 접촉·비해부학적 공예물 접합과 구별하며 생존·성장·종을 추정하지 않는다.
evidence_terms: bloom attached to its own stem
excludes: Anatomical contour, regional volume, relative proportion or part names alone without an actual ownership, continuity, articulation, attachment or intended-separation proposition.
Touching, nearness, overlap or visual alignment of separately owned subjects/objects alone; contact does not merge anatomy or establish a shared biological owner.

Object hinges, hardware branches, textile/lace/paper flower assemblies and floral graphic-path joins alone. Depicted anatomical connection requires an explicitly declared anatomical depiction and remains scoped there, never inferred live continuity.

Continuity/attachment does not prove that an owner is alive, growing, functional, healthy, a particular species or made by a particular process; a cut or depicted botanical part does not gain a hidden whole plant.

An artifact or picture cannot alter/add a living actor or plant merely because its design resembles a biological part. Actor/plant/representation owner labels, source effects and optional members/profiles are not independent anatomical evidence.
includes: Ownership and continuity, articulation or explicitly intended separation of declared human or other animal anatomical parts, retaining each actual owner and endpoint.

The declared botanical bloom remaining attached to its own woody stem; separate blossoms attaching along the same continuous branch; leaves belonging to that same declared plant/branch. Source-stated absence or separation is retained without inventing extra organs.

Explicit anatomical attachment/continuity within a declared representation remains on the represented anatomy. A flat ornament path or assembled craft junction alone does not establish an anatomical relation.

Where a fabric rosette and a separate existing biological flower coexist, their distinct owners remain distinct: the flower own petal/stem relation cannot be donated to the garment, and cloth attachment cannot be recast as plant growth.

full_spec.description: Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
full_spec.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸과 명시적으로 연결된 부위의 축 방향·상대 회전. 카메라 방향·전신 지지 자세·눈의 시선과 구별한다.
excludes: Camera position, body support pose, eye-gaze direction and a scene object facing the frame are not interchangeable.
Standing or an activity alone does not supply a rotation, connected region, angle, axis or reference basis.
Do not infer eyes, a nose, joints or a human torso from the role name or a mechanical subject.
includes: A declared body axis orientation or relative rotation of connected regions, with the actual regions, relation and reference basis stated.
A nonhuman or represented body can qualify on the same literal contract. Actual source conditions and available owner regions still apply.

full_spec.description: Explicit whole-body posture or support, or explicitly stated local non-hand articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body. Preserve the declared local part and its existing body ownership without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
full_spec.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸의 명시적 전신 자세·지지, 또는 직접 선언된 손 이외 국소 부위의 관절 자세. 실제 국소 부위와 기존 몸의 소유 관계를 보존하며 언급하지 않은 해부 부위나 지지 접촉을 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: A rigid object shape, a camera viewpoint or an activity word alone does not establish a whole-body pose.
Relative rotation of body axes, hand articulation, concrete action and rendered motion have separate roles when supported.
Do not turn an unavailable body or limb into a new entity to satisfy a pose.

Hand/finger articulation keeps hand_pose; explicit axis orientation or relative regional rotation keeps body_orientation. A local pose does not receive duplicate roles solely by renaming the same flexion as a rotation. A joint/hinge label, static object construction or generic believable movement alone does not supply a selected local articulated posture.
includes: Explicit standing, sitting, lying or other whole-body posture of a declared human, animal, robot or represented body.
Preserve the actual support and articulated connections when declared. Standing alone does not supply feet, legs, a supporting ground contact or a human body.
Decide effect versus a required existing posture from the whole source; source-specific category and domain conditions remain cumulative.

An explicitly bent elbow is a local articulated posture of that same owned elbow; it does not supply a full-body stance, an exact flexion angle, upper-arm/forearm inventory, a second actor or actual bending motion.

full_spec.description: Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.
full_spec.description_ko: 촬영 목적·기록 상황·접근과 관찰 조건: 장치 배치와 물리 촬영 구성은 capture_configuration; 기록 경위는 픽셀 사실이 아님
excludes: 장치 배치와 물리 촬영 구성은 capture_configuration; 기록 경위는 픽셀 사실이 아님
includes: Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.

full_spec.description: Contrast between a declared character's visible bearing, local response, role or status.
full_spec.description_ko: 한 인물의 태도·반응·역할 사이 대비: 권위와 주도권·계급 대비도 포함됨; 감정 모순으로만 정의하면 현재 후보 의미를 축소
excludes: 권위와 주도권·계급 대비도 포함됨; 감정 모순으로만 정의하면 현재 후보 의미를 축소
includes: Contrast between a declared character's visible bearing, local response, role or status.

full_spec.description: Explicit character goal or intended response used as narrative context, not a proven private mental state.
full_spec.description_ko: 명시된 인물의 목표와 반응 맥락: mid-handoff·공개 직전은 narrative_phase; 정체성 추론 금지는 정책이며 의도 후보가 아님
excludes: mid-handoff·공개 직전은 narrative_phase; 정체성 추론 금지는 정책이며 의도 후보가 아님
includes: Explicit character goal or intended response used as narrative context, not a proven private mental state.

full_spec.description: Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Includes expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks; not a proven private emotion, consciousness or hidden muscle action. Artificial and represented responses remain on their declared carriers.
full_spec.description_ko: 선언된 사람·동물의 관찰 가능한 얼굴·눈 주위 반응, 또는 명시된 인공 얼굴·얼굴 표현물에 실제로 드러난 표정 반응. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 표정성 눈썹 위치를 포함한다. 인공·묘사된 반응은 선언된 물체·표현물의 소유 범위에 머물며, 사적인 감정·의식·숨은 근육 작동이나 시선 방향·목표·눈맞춤을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 시선 목표와 사적인 마음 상태를 표정 사실로 취급하지 않음
Eye or iris direction, a named gaze target or camera/participant engagement alone; these properties require their own evidence and roles.
Consciousness, absence of mind, actual emotion, personality, intention, successful perception or hidden muscle operation inferred from an expression, including empty-looking machine gaze.
Face shape or proportions, sensor/optical-iris hardware, material, skin finish, grooming or cosmetic line alone without a positively declared facial response.

An artificial or represented facial response does not imply living skin, biological eyes or eyelids, newly added facial parts, a living carrier or an additional human/animal. Preserve the actual artificial or representation owner; do not convert it to biological anatomy.

Metadata, old slot names/effects, an optional member/profile, or an actor/object/representation owner label alone cannot supply a face, facial response or unconditional application scope. Intrinsic source conditions and independently frozen binding conditions remain conjunctive and unchanged.
includes: Observable facial or eye-area response of one declared human or animal, including expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks, without proving private emotion.

An explicitly declared artificial face presenting an empty-looking machine gaze or a too-precisely held social expression. The source must positively describe the visible facial response; robot identity or sensor hardware alone is insufficient.

A visible expression explicitly described on one declared face representation remains owned by that representation and its carrier. It neither creates a living actor nor transfers a depicted response to another subject. A generic facial resemblance or ornament label alone is insufficient.

full_spec.description: Owned eye or iris orientation toward a direction in the selected frame, independent of head orientation, a named gaze target and viewer engagement.
full_spec.description_ko: 같은 주체 눈·홍채의 선택 프레임 내 방향. 머리 방향·시선의 명명 대상·눈맞춤 여부와 독립하며 감은 눈이나 동공 모양으로 방향을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Head or body turn alone.
Eye closure, pupil shape or private intent.
Named gaze target or engagement alone.
includes: Upward iris direction without a named target.
An authored over-shoulder eye direction when that branch is selected.

full_spec.description: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.
full_spec.description_ko: 카메라·다른 참여자와 맺는 시선 관계: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
excludes: 현재 시선 방향·목표·눈 감음과 겹침; engagement 의미와 표정 요소를 재분류
includes: Declared visual engagement with the camera or another participant, separate from mere eye direction or closure.

full_spec.description: Explicit target of an identified gaze carrier, including a declared human or animal, with actual gaze-bearing scope and target grounded separately from head orientation, eye state and visual engagement.
full_spec.description_ko: 사람·동물을 포함한 명시된 시선 주체의 실제 관찰 목표. 시선 부위와 목표 소유 범위를 각각 증명하며, 머리 방향·눈 상태·눈맞춤·실제 인지 성공과 구별한다.
excludes: Head/body turn, pupil shape, eye closure, an empty-looking expression or a target location alone does not identify a gaze target.
A human/animal/robot/portrait label alone proves no eyes, gaze-bearing anatomy or performed gaze. Explicitly represented gaze remains on its represented carrier; biological anatomy is not donated.
Directed sensor/camera hardware, a lamp beam or device aiming alone is not biological or represented gaze. Artificial facial response alone is not gaze direction or a target.
Named target does not prove attention, successful seeing, consciousness, desire, camera awareness, engagement or target placement.
Do not add eyes, a face, phone or counterpart, or replace an independently selected secondary/background gaze carrier with a primary default.
includes: An explicitly declared human or animal looking at an identified existing target; source category does not change the same gaze-target meaning.
Looking into a phone camera supplies that named gaze target; it does not identify the camera actually recording the photograph or establish eye contact with the viewer.

Retain the exact gaze carrier, independently available relevant eye/gaze scope and actual target. Source/binding intrinsic restrictions stay conjunctive; select or preserve the gaze relation only as the whole source declares.

full_spec.description: Explicit color and color placement bounded to an identified hair region, wig or represented hair, distinct from scene grading and material identity.
full_spec.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역·가발·묘사된 머리에 한정된 명시적 색과 배치. 장면 색 보정·빛의 색·의복 색·재질 정체와 구별한다.
excludes: Illumination color, global image grading, general fur, a colored fiber object or an unowned color word alone is not hair-region color.
Do not infer dye chemistry, natural pigmentation, a wearer, follicles, hairstyle or another body region from the color.
A broader slot contract does not waive an intrinsic source-specific human or adult condition.
includes: A declared hair or wig color on its actual bounded region; a human wearer or natural living hair is not compulsory.
Keep the exact source color, placement, intrinsic subject restrictions and independently required region ownership.

full_spec.description: Explicit shape, length, arrangement or strand topology of an identified hair region or wig, separate from its color and material identity.
full_spec.description_ko: 실제 모발 영역이나 가발의 명시적 형태·길이·배치·가닥 연결. 색·재질과 분리하며 자연 모발·가발·묘사된 머리의 실제 소유자를 구별한다.
excludes: A synthetic fiber sheen alone does not supply a hairstyle or a living hair root.
General animal fur, a braided rope, a body-hair region and a hair-color word are not automatically a head-hair arrangement.
Do not introduce a wearer, head, scalp, follicles, hair identity or a new physical strand connection from a style name.
includes: An explicitly declared hair or wig arrangement with its actual owned region and strand continuity.
A standalone wig or represented hair can qualify without inventing a human wearer or biological follicles.
Source-specific wearer/category conditions and existing-region prerequisites remain mandatory.

full_spec.description: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.
full_spec.description_ko: 서사 해석의 단서: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.

full_spec.description: Central event, problem or relationship organizing the scene, distinct from a world system or a title alone.
full_spec.description_ko: 장면을 조직하는 중심 사건·관계·문제: secret garden 같은 제목과 world 전체 체계가 섞임; 단일 사건의 의미 근거 필요
excludes: secret garden 같은 제목과 world 전체 체계가 섞임; 단일 사건의 의미 근거 필요
includes: Central event, problem or relationship organizing the scene, distinct from a world system or a title alone.

full_spec.description: Explicitly declared off-frame participants, events or space and their visible relation, not automatically added actors.
full_spec.description_ko: 화면 밖 맥락: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicitly declared off-frame participants, events or space and their visible relation, not automatically added actors.

full_spec.description: Explicit participation or relational role of a declared participant, whether primary or secondary, without inferring identity, occupation or a new counterpart from appearance.
full_spec.description_ko: 주·보조 구분 없이 이미 명시된 참여자의 참여상·관계상 역할. 외모에서 정체·직업·관계를 추론하거나 역할 이름만으로 상대역을 추가하지 않는다.
excludes: Off-frame placement, a back view and person count belong to their independently supported framing/count roles.
A rival/partner label does not itself create another participant or establish actual identity, occupation, disposition or a performed interaction.
Role truth and tag fit remain separate from effect permission; a prerequisite role cannot authorize a new role or relationship.
includes: A declared participant role can belong to either the primary or another existing participant. The source must identify the actual role carrier and any independently required relation endpoints.

full_spec.description: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.
full_spec.description_ko: 물리 움직임 상태와 촬영된 움직임 표현: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
excludes: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
includes: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.

full_spec.description: Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
full_spec.description_ko: 명시된 행위 주체와 상대·물체 사이의 구체적 상호 동작. 인간·동물·기계·묘사된 대상을 포함하며 실제 행위와 소유·접촉 관계를 구별한다.
excludes: A role label, co-presence, proximity or an isolated hand pose does not supply a performed interaction.
Do not add a counterpart, helper, contact, tool or action endpoint from a verb category alone.
Do not split one actual self-owned body into two people or merge explicitly distinct participants.
includes: The source explicitly describes the participants or a participant and an object interacting; each endpoint must be independently supported.
Self-directed interaction can address an explicitly owned part or object while retaining its actual part/whole relationship.
A human participant is not compulsory. Intrinsic source conditions, distinctness or part ownership, and actual performed action remain mandatory.

whole_record.definition: Observable: an adult stops, redirects, refuses, or renegotiates an interaction through clear hand, gaze, and task cues.
Observable: a prior decision's harmless consequence and the adult's revised method appear in the same scene.
Observable: effort or sensory response is followed by an adult's visible choice to pause, adjust, or continue.
Observable: two adults exchange support and task responsibility rather than forming a one-way rescue pose.
Observable: an adult initiates a precise task and leaves a visible changed object or process state.
Observable: records temporary left-right movement asymmetry as an ambiguous moment, never a stable character trait.
Observable: one facial movement is paired with a visible body action, object, or scene cause.
Observable: head rotation and eye-gaze direction are separately specified and anatomically coherent.
Observable: describes visible brow, eyelid, cheek, or mouth movement only, without assigning personality, diagnosis, or moral value.
Observable: adult gaze vectors and optional hand cues converge on one practical target visible in frame.
Observable: a removed neutral accessory in hand and a matching compression or release boundary explain the new hair state.
Observable: a part line, fringe, mass, or outer contour remains a stable continuity anchor.
Observable: coherent gravity with a few delayed strands records a peak-motion or settling phase.
Observable: partially released strands, residual bends, and a visible neutral fastener establish tied-to-loose change.
Observable: droplets, clumping, weight, sheen, and reduced flyaways establish a plausible wet or drying state.
A concrete visible act of tending, repairing, supporting, teaching, preparing, or checking another subject or shared task.
Established adult competence remains visible while one bounded mistake, uncertainty, fatigue, or need for help is shown without infantilization.
One subject visibly leans or turns while the other maintains distance, making the spatial adjustment legible.
The relative gap between adult subjects is visibly framed together with the scene constraint that permits it.
Both torsos or head directions visibly converge toward each other or the shared task.
Both subjects visibly attend to the same object work surface or event.
A handoff object tool work surface or obstacle visibly explains the subjects' reach and spacing.
One restrained inward elbow hand or shoulder gesture is visible without compressing every limb into an infantilized pose.
The standing or seated silhouette has a clearly readable vertical balance line and supported base.
Hip shoulder and support-foot alignment visibly show weight transferred toward or away from the current task.
